This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1 which must be carried out 
when there is leakage from level glass for high pressure drum.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdalla Sharf, tested by eng. Aly 
Zakaria Kandil, accepted by general director eng. Abdo Abdo Elhendawy, revised 
by EDEPC quality control eng. Zakaria El-Shahat, approved by eng. 
Mohamed Hussein Gomaa : quality insurance head sector

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, ... etc
Close the isolate valves for level glass
Wait level glass to be cold
Internal inspection for evidence of corrosion or scaling
Clean internal parts from the foreign bodies
Check the glass replace if defect
Check the mica change the defect
Worming the level glass slowly by opening the valves at min flow
Retighten the bolts after worming and make the level glass in service
